theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.identityA (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, hook μ c ^ 2 = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, content c ^ 2 + numCells μ ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.statistics_combine (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c ^ 2 + ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c ^ 2 + ∑ _c ∈ μ.cells, 1 + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c * leg μ c + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, content c ^ 2 + numCells μ ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.two_sum_armleg (μ : YoungDiagram) :
2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c * leg μ c = numCells μ ^ 2 + numCells μ - ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.rowLen c.1) - ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.colLen c.2) - 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1 * ↑c.2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_colLen_cells (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.colLen c.2) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c + ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1 + numCells μ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_rowLen_cells (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.rowLen c.1) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c + ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.2 + numCells μ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_leg_eq_sum_row (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_eq_sum_col (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_diag_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
↑{p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.1.2 = p.2.2}.card = numCells μ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_colEq_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
↑{p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.2 = p.2.2}.card = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.colLen c.2)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_rowEq_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
↑{p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.1 = p.2.1}.card = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑(μ.rowLen c.1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_product_partition (μ : YoungDiagram) :
(μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells).card + {p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.1.2 = p.2.2}.card = (bigNE μ).card + (bigSW μ).card + (bigNW μ).card + (bigSE μ).card + {p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.1 = p.2.1}.card + {p ∈ μ.cells ×ˢ μ.cells | p.1.2 = p.2.2}.card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_bigNW_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
↑(bigNW μ).card = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, ↑c.1 * ↑c.2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_bigSE_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
(bigSE μ).card = (bigNW μ).card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.card_bigSW_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) :
(bigSW μ).card = (bigNE μ).card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_armleg_eq_card_bigNE (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c * leg μ c = ↑(bigNE μ).card

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.fiber_card (μ : YoungDiagram) (i j : ℕ) (_h : (i, j) ∈ μ) :
{p ∈ bigNE μ | p.1.1 = i ∧ p.2.2 = j}.card = (μ.rowLen i - j - 1) * (μ.colLen j - i - 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_leg_sq_eq_sum_isq (μ : YoungDiagram) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_sq_eq_sum_jsq (μ : YoungDiagram) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_sq_row (μ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.row i, arm μ c ^ 2 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i), ↑j ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_transpose_swap (μ : YoungDiagram) (g : ℕ × ℕ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.transpose.cells, g c = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, g c.swap

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_row_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) (f : ℕ × ℕ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.row i, f c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i), f (i, j)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_leg_cells (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.transpose.colLen 0), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (μ.transpose.rowLen i), ↑k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_cells (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i), ↑k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_row (μ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.row i, arm μ c = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i), ↑k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_cells_fiberwise (μ : YoungDiagram) (f : ℕ × ℕ → ℤ) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, f c = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), ∑ c ∈ μ.row i, f c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_arm_transpose_eq_sum_leg (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.transpose.cells, arm μ.transpose c = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.leg_eq_arm_transpose (μ : YoungDiagram) (c : ℕ × ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.content_swap (c : ℕ × ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sumSq_hook_expand (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ c ∈ μ.cells, hook μ c ^ 2 = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c ^ 2 + ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c ^ 2 + ∑ _c ∈ μ.cells, 1 + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c * leg μ c + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, arm μ c + 2 * ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, leg μ c

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.IdentityAArmLeg.sum_one_eq_numCells (μ : YoungDiagram) :
